name: Aqua Security - Host Security and Compliance
description: Aqua Security - Host Security and Compliance dashboard monitors host scanning for compliance issues in nodes that fail Aquaâs CIS benchmarks for Kubernetes, Docker and Linux.
title: Aqua Security - Host Security and Compliance

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Aqua "policy.failure" "host.policy"
| json "rule_type", "result", "category", "action", "podnamespace", "poddeployment", "reason", "containerid", "resource", "data", "user" nodrop
| json "image" as host nodrop
| json field=data "controls", "policy_id", "policy_name", "blocking" nodrop
| toLowerCase(action) as action_f | toLowerCase(user) as user_f 
| where action_f = "policy.failure" and user_f = "host.policy"
| parse regex field=controls "\"(?<control>.+?)\"" multi
| count_distinct(host) as distinct_hosts by host, control
| sort by host
